text:
maria: Quick thread to finalize DP recruitment prioritization + feedback intensity matrix. Goal: 16 partners, 4-week pilots, split across two start waves. Need a screening rubric that avoids noise and clarifies pass/fail and handoff criteria.

devin: Ops capacity check: baseline support for 5 active partners with full instrumentation. With onboarding automation and one scripted health-check we can handle 10 concurrently. For 16 we'll do staggered waves and a rotating 2-person ops window. Need SSO/Private flags in intake.

sam: UX input: we'll own the structured task pack (integration tasks + 8 golden prompts) and the partner interview script. Recommend two async artifacts from partners: 1) short Loom showing integration, 2) a 10-prompt eval set. Weekly 15m sync + optional ad-hoc pads. Keep surveys 3-5 Qs.

ashok: CS: screening priority = teams with a named product owner + production-like traffic. Acceptance signals: 70% weekly active usage and at least one primary feature used by >=20% of flows. SLA to respond to blockers within 48h. Log every issue in tracker.

juno: Draft intake form (minimal fields):
```
- org_name
- contact_email + timezone
- company_size
- primary_use_case (1 line)
- est_monthly_tokens
- data_sensitivity: public|internal|regulated
- sso_required: yes/no
- can_provide_eval_prompts: yes/no
- preferred_start_wave: A|B
- nda_agree: checkbox
```

maria: Compensation tiers idea (novel):
- Foundational: $4k credits + early API access
- Growth: $2k credits + pilot discount 50% for 2 months
- Observational: credits only
Also a small success bonus ($1k) for a published case study. Pilot terms = NDA + one-page summary.

devin: New ops guardrail: a change-exposure matrix. Any infra/model change gets a partner impact score (0-5). Score >=3 requires canary for cohorts and pre-notify partners. If partner-specific evals drop >5% absolute on their golden prompts within 24h, auto-roll back for that cohort. Reserve a 12% rescue capacity pool for incidents.

sam: Feedback intensity matrix (unique): map partners to low/medium/high engagement tiers based on willingness to run weekly evals + meeting cadence. High-engagement partners get weekly eval automation + prioritized triage, medium get biweekly, low just a digest. We'll surface this tier on the intake form.

oliver: Metrics proposal for scorecard: reliability (latency p50, p95, error rate), quality (avg semantic-sim delta on golden prompts, human-rated quality 1-5), adoption (active users %, primary-feature adoption %), and engagement (meeting attendance, prompt-delivery cadence). Pass threshold = weighted score >=70.

maria: Handoff playbook to sales/product: include numeric score, top 3 blockers, recommended next step (POC/contract/observe), marketing opt-in, and expected ARR uplift estimate if partner converts. Keep it one page.

ashok: Exit/Remediation policy: if metrics underperform by week 3, initiate remediation sprint (config tuning, quantization adjustments, routing changes) for 7 days. If still below threshold, offer partial credit or end pilot. Capture partner consent to remediation step in intake.

metrics-bot: Reminder: add thread to project board 'dp-priority-plan'. Auto-create scorecard template and assign deadlines.

maria: Action items: @devin onboarding script + change-exposure matrix by Wed COB; @sam task pack + interview script by Wed; @juno intake form + outreach copy by Mon EOD; @oliver scorecard spreadsheet + weights by Tue. We'll run a 30m alignment Wed 10am. Thanks! :rocket:
